name: Macedonian Dynasty Feudal All In
author: Edz

notes: First 6 to sheep @resource/sheep.webp@, 1 build Varangian War Camp @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@
Next 3 go back to food @resource/sheep.webp@ then at around 2:15 use 3 to build Hyperdome @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@
Move 1 more villager to gold then start rallying villagers to wood

Continue to distribute villagers to wood and gold. Build a Mill @building_economy/mill.webp@ near berries and research Pro Scout @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@, start producing scout once Pro Scout Hyperdome @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ is complete. Build upto 5 scout (Include 1 free from Hyperdome)
Build house as needed, once Pro Scout @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ completed and start gathering Deer @resource/deer.webp@
Research Eco Tech in this order  @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@
Once have 100 wood build Varangian Arsenal @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ then additional 200 wood build Varangian Stronghold @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@

Keep on building Varangian Stronghold @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ when you have 200 wood and continue to build Varangian Guard @unit_macedonian/varangian-2.webp@@unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@

Research @technology_macedonian/butted-chainmail-2.webp@@technology_macedonian/pattern-welding-2.webp@ attack enemy at around 10 minutes mark with @unit_macedonian/varangian-2.webp@@unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@

description: Pressure opponent in Feudal age and win the game around 10 minutes mark
